name: Asakura Yuma
source:
"...after all... I'm.... just something that you can't do anything about...." 

A girl being used by the PGG. She can manipulate the world of computers at will. She lives in the past. Gloomy. She's reconciled to her fate. 

 Battle quote - "Target confirmed. Commencing... destruction..."
[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
